caption: Rows D1 to D3 are domains; columns F1 to F4 are objects. D1's read on F1 and D3's read-write on F4 are marked to show how one cell answers one access question.

spec.title: Access matrix: rows are domains D1 to D3, columns are objects F1 to F4
spec.aria: A three by four matrix where domain D1 has read on F1, read-write on F2 and execute on F4, D2 has read on F2 and read-write on F3, and D3 has read on F1 and read-write on F4.
